the induction of protective T cells in F1 mice and the role of the MHC haplotypic background in the regulation of the induction of pathogenic T cell responses.
the role of T cell responses in the pathogenesis and resistance to TMEV-induced disease.

a balance of protective CD8+ T cells and pathogenic Th17 cells is crucial in determining disease susceptibility.
